clusters.name: scope-guardrail-preflight
clusters.executionModeRationale: Record the operator-approved single-tenant supersession of the fork's never-happy.evyatar.dev/Cloudflare guardrail before implementation starts, so work does not begin from a constraint violation.

clusters.name: server-auth-plane
clusters.executionModeRationale: All five mutate the same happy-server auth plane and depend on the shared happy-wire envelope; serialize to define schema/vectors first, then verifier + decisive acceptance test before exposure.

clusters.name: cli-provider
clusters.executionModeRationale: happy-cli is disjoint; public bind + pairing-invite ship only after the verifier is proven.

clusters.name: app-proof
clusters.executionModeRationale: happy-app files exclusive; BOOX enrollment depends on the CLI pairing invite + fixed proof/Access-token envelope.

clusters.name: codex-gate
clusters.executionModeRationale: Separate codex submodule; /remote on keeps local 127.0.0.1 attach, depends on persisted public-listener machine-state contract.

clusters.name: edge-ops
clusters.executionModeRationale: Cloudflare Access service-token policy + WS-proof depends on the public provider and app header path.

clusters.name: docs
clusters.executionModeRationale: Docs lockstep after all behavior lands.
